question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is** "foster."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Foster"** means to encourage or promote the development of something. ((विशेषतः भावों या विचारों के) विकास को प्रोत्‍साहित करना; संवर्धित करना) • **Example**: *The company aims to **foster**__ a culture of innovation among its employees.* • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: The automobile industry is one of the __leading__ industries at the global level. It plays a crucial role in the development of the global economy because of the high revenues and increased customer demands. The automobile industry helps to __**foster**__ economic development of the country; therefore, it is widely recognised as a major economic sector. The automobile industry consists of multiple companies ______ (3) _______ in car manufacturing, as well as the ones involved in marketing and distribution of automobile products, such as cars, buses, vans, trucks, motorcycles, mopeds and ______ (4) ________ bicycles. The global automobile industry incorporates several large car manufacturers' blocs that work ______ (5) ______ at the global level. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Release"** means to set free or allow to go. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना) • **"Block"** means to prevent something from happening or being achieved. (किसी कार्य को पूरा होने से रोकना; रोड़े अटकाना) • **"Arrest"** means to take someone into custody for a crime. (गिरफ़्तार करना; बंदी बनाना) 3f:Tea1, The correct answer is **"specialized."**
